bodyParagraphs: UNESCO and CodeAI plan an online workshop on November 19, 2026. It is for teachers in Latin America and the Caribbean. Teachers will use pictures of fish and marine waste to explore how AI learns from examples. Sorting these pictures can reveal how a system makes choices. The activity also helps teachers notice errors and biases. No earlier programming knowledge is needed for the exercise.
